==Notes==

*Snow Wurms drop warrior [[skill tome]]s.
*They are useful for experience towards [[Survivor]] due to their low damage. There is a group of 13 north of [[Boreal Station]]. This is also a good place to take your new [[pet]] to solo them into a Dire evolution.
*These wurms are the [[Eye of the North]] equivalent of the [[Plague Worm]]s found in the field outside [[Ashford Abbey]] in [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|pre-Searing Ascalon]].
*While burrowed, they will continue to take damage from [[spirit]]s, [[health degeneration]], pets, or a [[projectile spell]] that was shot before the wurm burrowed. 

{{bug|When killed under the surface, its death will not count towards the [[Vanquisher]] kill count and its [[drop]] will appear on the surface where you were fighting it. }}
